WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(1.0 * m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_record_count
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios
  WHERE insurstat IS NOT NULL AND avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
kept_sites AS (
  SELECT r.zoneregistry, r.insurstat, r.avg_ratio, a.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios AS r
  JOIN status_averages AS a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat
  WHERE r.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
    AND r.avg_ratio > a.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT
  insurstat,
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_site_ratio,
  COUNT(*) AS kept_site_count,
  AVG(avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status_average
FROM kept_sites
GROUP BY insurstat;
